# NIMBUS (22 · nimbus)

Weather for the inside of your head — fbm clouds with three switchable moods, including lightning.

- **Technique:** CLOUD SHADER
- **Tags:** weather, calm, dreamy, wellness, app, soft, sky, mood
- **Best for:** wellness & meditation apps; consumer apps; mood products
- **Fonts:** Gloock, Hanken Grotesk
- **Fonts href:** `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Gloock&family=Hanken+Grotesk:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,500;1,300&display=swap`
- **Swatch:** #2b3242 · #f2c9a8 · #e8a87c
- **Dependencies:** none beyond the shared helpers
- **Source:** `src/templates/nimbus/` (Template.astro, content.ts, hero.ts, meta.ts, rain.ts, sky.ts, style.css, theme.css)

## Tokens — `theme.css`
Every color and font stack the design uses. Override per site; canvas/WebGL effects read these at init.

```css
/* nimbus — design tokens. Override any of these per site via `theme` (inline on <html>). */
:root {
  --slate: #2b3242;
  --slate2: #222836;
  --deep: #181d28;
  --peach: #f2c9a8;
  --peach2: #e8a87c;
  --cream: #f2e6d8;
  --dim: #a5aebf;
  --faint: #5d6678;
  --scroll-thumb: #333c50;

  /* Sky shader: per-mood gradient (bot→top) and cloud lit/shade colors. */
  --dawn-top: #6b7a9e;
  --dawn-bot: #f29e6b;
  --dawn-lit: #ffe0bd;
  --dawn-shade: #9e8085;
  --storm-top: #212636;
  --storm-bot: #4d5466;
  --storm-lit: #8c91a1;
  --storm-shade: #292b38;
  --rain-top: #3b4559;
  --rain-bot: #6b758a;
  --rain-lit: #adb5c7;
  --rain-shade: #4d5466;
  /* Sun glow (dawn), lightning flash and rain streaks. */
  --sun-core: #ffb86b;
  --sun-halo: #ff804d;
  --flash: #e6ebff;
  --rain-drop: #dce4f0;

  --serif: "Gloock", serif;
  --sans: "Hanken Grotesk", sans-serif;
  --ease: cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1);
}
```

## Signature effects
- `hero.ts`
  - `initHero(header: HTMLElement)` — Start the sky + rain layers inside `header` and wire the `.mode[data-mode]` buttons to them.
- `rain.ts`
  - `initRain(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement)` — 130 falling streaks on a transparent canvas, faded in/out by CSS opacity. No animation under reduced motion.
- `sky.ts`
  - `initSky(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement)` — Fullscreen fbm cloud shader. Mood palettes come from the `--<mood>-top|bot|lit|shade` tokens and ease toward the selected mood each frame; the storm mood fires lightning flashes. Falls back to a CSS gradient (`.no-gl`) without WebGL, or removes the canvas if the shader fails.

## Content model — `content.ts`
Every user-visible string lives here. Fields ending in `Html` are trusted inline HTML (`<em> <b> <i> <br> <a> <span>`).

```ts
/** Fields ending in `Html` are trusted, author-written HTML (inline <em>/<b>/<i>/<a>/<br> only). */
export interface Link {
  label: string;
  href: string;
}

/** Sky moods the shader knows how to render. Colors for each live in theme.css as `--<id>-top|bot|lit|shade`. */
export type MoodId = 'dawn' | 'storm' | 'rain';

export interface Mood {
  id: MoodId;
  /** Emoji/glyph beside the label. */
  icon: string;
  label: string;
  /** Small line under the label. */
  hint: string;
}

export interface Feature {
  /** Small italic counter, e.g. "No. 1". */
  no: string;
  title: string;
  text: string;
}

export interface Content {
  seo: { title: string; description: string; ogTitle?: string; ogDescription?: string };
  /** Wordmark in nav + footer, e.g. `nimbus<i>.</i>` (the <i> is the accent dot). */
  wordmarkHtml: string;
  /** In-page nav. Sections carry the ids `why`, `words` and `get`. */
  nav: Link[];
  hero: {
    /** aria-label of the sky canvas. */
    skyLabel: string;
    headingHtml: string;
    text: string;
    /** aria-label of the mood button group. */
    moodsLabel: string;
    /** Small caption above the mood buttons. */
    moodsCaption: string;
    /** Mood buttons in display order; the first is selected on load and must be 'dawn'. */
    moods: Mood[];
  };
  why: {
    kicker: string;
    headingHtml: string;
    features: Feature[];
  };
  words: {
    kicker: string;
    /** Blockquote body including its typographic quotes. */
    quoteHtml: string;
    cite: string;
  };
  get: {
    heading: string;
    text: string;
    cta: Link;
  };
  footer: {
    noteHtml: string;
    creditHtml: string;
  };
  /** Showcase-only chrome; rendered when the template's `showcase` prop is true. */
  showcase?: {
    chipLabel: string;
    chipHref: string;
    footerHtml: string;
  };
}
```
